guidetextdraw._value: INSTRUCTONS: You listed one or more dependents other than a spouse in your household on your 2021-2022 California Dream Act Application(CDA). In order for us to determine whether or not such individuals may be considered your “dependents” for financial aid purposes, you must provide the following information to verify and explain the relationships of each person to you. You must also have adequate income to provide for your own support and more than half of the support of the dependent(s) listed. Incomplete documents will not be returned. They will be disposed of in a secure manner, per university policy. This will delay processing.
